info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Meetings Meetings Notes-v1-spec
info.description: The Meeting Notes Retrieval API enables users to access meeting notes associated with specific meetings. Designed for project managers and team members, this API streamlines the process of retrieving detailed notes, ensuring that important information is easily accessible. Users can query notes based on meeting identifiers, allowing for quick reference and enhanced collaboration. Common use cases include reviewing previous discussions, tracking decisions made, and referencing action items from past meetings.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch notes related to meetings, providing insights and details that may help in understanding meeting discussions and decisions.
